## Summary

The project uses a **pooled, network-synchronized (Photon PUN) skill-effect system**. Skill projectiles spawn a *pair* of pooled objects per shot — a visual `ParticleSystem` VFX object plus a separate invisible "trigger" collider object — bound together by an `AttackToken`. Effects are categorized by `Element` (Common/Fire/Lightning/Winter/Grass), each mapping to its own object pool (defined in `PoolConst`/`ObjectPoolConst`). Hit effects play from dedicated "Hit" pools and auto-return via `Invoke`. There is no single central "EffectManager"; spawning is decentralized across per-character `AttackRange_*` spawners, `ImpactCannon`/`GuiLingBase` projectile controllers, and the `CastNetwork` RPC bridge.

## 1. Skill / Projectile Spawners (effect spawning entry points)

**`Assets\_Project\Scripts\Controllers\Combat\AttackRange_WizardBoy.cs`** — class `AttackRange_WizardBoy` (WizardBoy character). Overrides `PerformAttack()`: gets spawn pos + direction, plays SFX `sfx_wizard_fire`, picks a visual pool by element (`ImpactCannonCommon/Lighten/Winter/GrassPool`), fetches pooled VFX + `ImpactCannonTriggerPool` trigger, builds an `AttackToken`, calls `particle.GetComponentInChildren<ParticleSystem>().Play()` and orients VFX. Local-then-network: `SpawnFireballLocal(... isMine:true)` then `_networkCaster.RequestFireball(...)`.

**`Assets\_Project\Scripts\Controllers\Combat\AttackRange_BingNv.cs`** — class `AttackRange_BingNv` (冰女/Ice Girl). GuiLing (鬼灵弹) emitter. Multi-target locking + horizontal/vertical spread. Maps element → GuiLing pool via `GetGuiLingPoolByElement` (PoolConst.GuiLingFire/Lightning/Grass/WinterPool).

## 2. Projectile / Effect Behavior Controllers (play & manage VFX at runtime)

**`Assets\_Project\Scripts\Controllers\Combat\ImpactCannon.cs`** — class `ImpactCannon : TriggerBase, IImpactCannon`. The WizardBoy fireball. `PlayHitEffect()` fetches pooled hit VFX by element (`ImpactCannonHit*Pool`) and plays `ParticleSystem`. `CreateSplitBullet()` spawns split-bullet VFX+trigger pairs. `RecycleWithEffect()` → `token.RecycleAll()` returns VFX + trigger to pools. Reads max-attack-count via `SkillQueryEventChannelSO`.

**`Assets\_Project\Scripts\Controllers\Combat\GuiLingBase.cs`** — class `GuiLingBase`. Two-stage homing projectile (spread → track). `PlayHitEffectFromPool()` derives the Hit pool from the projectile pool name and spawns hit VFX with layer/visibility culling. Manages `trails` (List<GameObject> with ParticleSystems), split missiles, target re-acquisition, and pooled return. Calls `_castNetwork.BroadcastGuiLingHitVFX(...)`.

**`Assets\_Project\Scripts\Controllers\Combat\GuiLingHit.cs`** — class `GuiLingHit`. Auto-play/auto-return hit-effect script: `OnEnable()` → `_ps.Play()` + `Invoke(ReturnToPool, duration)` (duration derived from ParticleSystem main.duration + startLifetime). Returns to its named pool.

**`Assets\_Project\Scripts\Controllers\Combat\FIreBallProjectile.cs`** — class `FIreBallProjectile` (Boss fireball). Parabolic/homing projectile with `LineRenderer` trajectory preview. `OnHitTarget()` does `Instantiate(hitEffect, transform.position, Quaternion.identity)` (note: this one uses raw Instantiate, not pooling) and raises `playerDamageEventChannel`.

**`Assets\_Project\Scripts\Controllers\Combat\RayBeam.cs`** — class `RayBeam`. Simple boss bite/raybeam trigger that raises player-damage events (no VFX spawning itself).

**`Assets\_Project\Scripts\Controllers\Combat\FireBallBase.cs`** — fireball base (companion to FIreBallProjectile).

**`Assets\_Project\Scripts\Controllers\Combat\ImportFXHandle.cs`** — class `ImportFXHandle`. Minimal auto-return helper: `OnDisable()` raises a pool Return event for `poolName`. Attached to imported FX prefabs.

Element-variant siblings in the same folder: `ImpactCannonHit.cs`, `ImpactCannonCommon.cs`/`ImpactCannonCommonGrass/Winter/Lighten.cs` (per-element impact-cannon implementations).

## 3. Network Skill/Effect Synchronization

**`Assets\_Project\Scripts\Controllers\Network\CastNetwork.cs`** — class `CastNetwork : MonoBehaviourPun, INetworkFireballCaster`. Central RPC hub for replicating skill VFX to other clients. `RequestFireball`/`RPC_OnFireballCast` → `SpawnFireballForOthers` (plays pooled `ParticleSystem`, builds token, `ImpactCannon.StartShoot(isMine:false)`). `RequestGuiLingCast`/`BroadcastSplitGuiLingCast`/`BroadcastGuiLingHitVFX`/`RequestSplitBullet` mirror GuiLing casting, splits, and hit VFX across the network. `BroadcastDamage`/`RPC_DealDamage`/`RPC_ShowDamageNum` sync damage + pooled damage-number popups. Maps Element → pool via `GetVisualPoolByElement`/`GetHitPoolByElement`/`GetGuiLingPoolByElement`/`GetGuiLingHitPoolByElement`.

**`Assets\_Project\Scripts\Controllers\Network\INetworkFireballCaster.cs`** — interface implemented by `CastNetwork`.

## 4. Effect Pooling Infrastructure (runtime instantiation backbone)

**`Assets\_Project\Scripts\Core\PoolHelper.cs`** — static class `PoolHelper`. Zero-GC hot path: `Get(poolName, pos)` → `ObjectPoolManager.GetFromPoolAndActivate`; `Return(poolName, obj)`. Used by all effect spawners.

**`Assets\_Project\Scripts\Core\ObjectPoolManager.cs`** — the pool manager backing `PoolHelper`.

**`Assets\_Project\Scripts\Core\PoolConst.cs`** / **`Assets\_Project\Scripts\Core\PoolConfigSO.cs`** — all effect pool-name constants: `ImpactCannonCommon/Lighten/Winter/GrassPool`, `ImpactCannonHit*Pool`, `ImpactCannonTriggerPool`, `GuiLing{Fire/Lightning/Winter/Grass}Pool`, `GuiLingHit{...}Pool`, `DamageNumPool`, `FireFirePool`, etc.

**`Assets\_Project\Scripts\Core\AttackToken.cs`** — class `AttackToken`. Binds a hit-collider GameObject + VFX GameObject + vfxPoolName; `RecycleAll()` returns both to their pools. Central to the VFX+trigger pairing pattern.

**`Assets\_Project\Scripts\Controllers\Network\NetworkObjectPoolManager.cs`** — networked pool manager (5 effect/pool Instantiate-Play occurrences).

## 5. PowerUp / Rune / Boss Effects

**`Assets\_Project\Scripts\Controllers\PowerUp\PowerUpEffectBase.cs`** — abstract class `PowerUpEffectBase : IPowerUpEffect`. `PlayCollectEffects()` does `Instantiate(collectVFX, pos, Quaternion.identity)` + `PlayClipAtPoint`. Other PowerUp files: `IPowerUpEffect.cs`, `ExperienceMagnetEffect.cs`, and `PowerUpManager.cs` (1 occurrence).

**`Assets\_Project\Scripts\Controllers\Rune\RuneEffectApplier.cs`** — static class `RuneEffectApplier`. Applies rune stat effects to player attributes (Lua hot-update + SO fallback). Stat-only; does not spawn VFX.

**`Assets\_Project\Scripts\Controllers\Enemy\Boss_Horror.cs`** — class `SpiderBoss : EnemyBase` (974 lines, file is named Boss_Horror). Boss attacks: Bite, RayBeam (single fireball), FireballBurst (consecutive fireballs), Roll. Holds `rayBeamPrefab`/`fireballPrefab` and spawns boss projectiles.

**`Assets\_Project\Scripts\Controllers\Character\Pets\Charmander.cs`** — pet that references ParticleSystem (pet VFX).

## 6. Event Channel (skill query / damage)

**`Assets\_Project\Scripts\Core\EventSystem\SkillQueryEventChannelSO.cs`** — `SkillQueryEventChannelSO` used by `ImpactCannon` to query `GetMaxAttackCount` (skill-level stat). `DamageEventArgs.cs`/`DamageDisplayEventArgs.cs` carry hit data; `damageEventChannel`/`playerDamageEventChannel` raise damage consumed by effects/numbers.

## 7. Third-party / Imported FX Scripts (mostly asset-store, reusable)

- `Assets\ImportAssets\JMO Assets\Cartoon FX Remaster\CFXR Assets\Scripts\CFXR_Effect.cs` (+ `CFXR_Effect.CameraShake.cs`, `CFXR_EmissionBySurface.cs`, `CFXR_ParticleText.cs`) — Cartoon FX Remaster effect controllers; `CFXR_Demo.cs` in Demo Assets.
- `Assets\ImportAssets\特效\Hovl Studio\Toon Projectiles 2\Scripts\AutoDestroyPS.cs` / `ProjectileMover.cs` — auto-destroy particle + projectile mover.
- `Assets\ImportAssets\Piloto Studio\Scripts\ParticleHandler.cs` / `ParticleShowcase.cs`.
- `Assets\ImportAssets\Vefects\Trails VFX URP\Scripts\Demo_TurningAroundEffect.cs`.
- `Assets\Effects\QFX\ProjectilesFX\VFX_Resources\Scripts\PFX_ProjectileObject.cs`, `PFX_ProjectileObjectWeapon.cs`, `PFX_ProjectileParticlesWeapon.cs`; demo `DemoEffects.cs`.
- `Assets\SF Studio\Shared\Modules\ProjectileSystem\Scripts\DefaultProjectile.cs` / `ProjectileSpawner.cs` — generic projectile system.
- `Assets\SF Studio\Shared\Modules\ParticleSystemUtils\Scripts\Editor\*Editor.cs` — editor utilities (emission multiplier / sorting layer/order).

## Key runtime effect-instantiation pattern (evidence)
```
// AttackRange_WizardBoy / ImpactCannon / CastNetwork
PoolHelper.Get(visualPool, spawnPos)  → GameObject with ParticleSystem → .Play()
PoolHelper.Get(ImpactCannonTriggerPool, spawnPos) → collider (ImpactCannon)
new AttackToken { hitCollider, vfxEffect, vfxPoolName }  // binds them
// On hit: PoolHelper.Get(ImpactCannonHit*Pool, hitPos).GetComponentInChildren<ParticleSystem>().Play()
// On expire: token.RecycleAll()  →  PoolHelper.Return(...)
```
Pool names all come from `PoolConst` / `ObjectPoolConst`. `GuiLingHit`/`ImportFXHandle` auto-return on disable/Invoke. Note `FIreBallProjectile` and `PowerUpEffectBase.PlayCollectEffects` use raw `Instantiate(...)` rather than the pool system.

## Search coverage notes
- `特效|PlayEffect|SpawnEffect|CastSkill` → 15 files; `ParticleSystem|InstantiateEffect|EffectPool|VFXManager|EffectManager` → 27 files; plus glob sweeps for `*Effect*`, `*Skill*`, `*Cast*`, `*Particle*`, `*Projectile*`, `*VFX*`. No `VFX*.cs` filenames exist; VFX is named "Effect"/"FX"/"PS" inside.
- No dedicated `VFXManager`/`EffectManager`/`EffectPool` class exists — pooling is the de-facto effect manager via `PoolHelper`/`ObjectPoolManager` + `AttackToken`.
- `MagicUpgradeManager.cs` and `UI/Other/SpawnPoint.cs` matched the `特效`/`ParticleSystem` search but are UI/spawn-point helpers, not core skill-effect controllers.

args.result:
## Summary

The project uses a **pooled, network-synchronized (Photon PUN) skill-effect system**. Skill projectiles spawn a *pair* of pooled objects per shot — a visual `ParticleSystem` VFX object plus a separate invisible "trigger" collider object — bound together by an `AttackToken`. Effects are categorized by `Element` (Common/Fire/Lightning/Winter/Grass), each mapping to its own object pool (defined in `PoolConst`/`ObjectPoolConst`). Hit effects play from dedicated "Hit" pools and auto-return via `Invoke`. There is no single central "EffectManager"; spawning is decentralized across per-character `AttackRange_*` spawners, `ImpactCannon`/`GuiLingBase` projectile controllers, and the `CastNetwork` RPC bridge.

## 1. Skill / Projectile Spawners (effect spawning entry points)

**`Assets\_Project\Scripts\Controllers\Combat\AttackRange_WizardBoy.cs`** — class `AttackRange_WizardBoy` (WizardBoy character). Overrides `PerformAttack()`: gets spawn pos + direction, plays SFX `sfx_wizard_fire`, picks a visual pool by element (`ImpactCannonCommon/Lighten/Winter/GrassPool`), fetches pooled VFX + `ImpactCannonTriggerPool` trigger, builds an `AttackToken`, calls `particle.GetComponentInChildren<ParticleSystem>().Play()` and orients VFX. Local-then-network: `SpawnFireballLocal(... isMine:true)` then `_networkCaster.RequestFireball(...)`.

**`Assets\_Project\Scripts\Controllers\Combat\AttackRange_BingNv.cs`** — class `AttackRange_BingNv` (冰女/Ice Girl). GuiLing (鬼灵弹) emitter. Multi-target locking + horizontal/vertical spread. Maps element → GuiLing pool via `GetGuiLingPoolByElement` (PoolConst.GuiLingFire/Lightning/Grass/WinterPool).

## 2. Projectile / Effect Behavior Controllers (play & manage VFX at runtime)

**`Assets\_Project\Scripts\Controllers\Combat\ImpactCannon.cs`** — class `ImpactCannon : TriggerBase, IImpactCannon`. The WizardBoy fireball. `PlayHitEffect()` fetches pooled hit VFX by element (`ImpactCannonHit*Pool`) and plays `ParticleSystem`. `CreateSplitBullet()` spawns split-bullet VFX+trigger pairs. `RecycleWithEffect()` → `token.RecycleAll()` returns VFX + trigger to pools. Reads max-attack-count via `SkillQueryEventChannelSO`.

**`Assets\_Project\Scripts\Controllers\Combat\GuiLingBase.cs`** — class `GuiLingBase`. Two-stage homing projectile (spread → track). `PlayHitEffectFromPool()` derives the Hit pool from the projectile pool name and spawns hit VFX with layer/visibility culling. Manages `trails` (List<GameObject> with ParticleSystems), split missiles, target re-acquisition, and pooled return. Calls `_castNetwork.BroadcastGuiLingHitVFX(...)`.

**`Assets\_Project\Scripts\Controllers\Combat\GuiLingHit.cs`** — class `GuiLingHit`. Auto-play/auto-return hit-effect script: `OnEnable()` → `_ps.Play()` + `Invoke(ReturnToPool, duration)` (duration derived from ParticleSystem main.duration + startLifetime). Returns to its named pool.

**`Assets\_Project\Scripts\Controllers\Combat\FIreBallProjectile.cs`** — class `FIreBallProjectile` (Boss fireball). Parabolic/homing projectile with `LineRenderer` trajectory preview. `OnHitTarget()` does `Instantiate(hitEffect, transform.position, Quaternion.identity)` (note: this one uses raw Instantiate, not pooling) and raises `playerDamageEventChannel`.

**`Assets\_Project\Scripts\Controllers\Combat\RayBeam.cs`** — class `RayBeam`. Simple boss bite/raybeam trigger that raises player-damage events (no VFX spawning itself).

**`Assets\_Project\Scripts\Controllers\Combat\FireBallBase.cs`** — fireball base (companion to FIreBallProjectile).

**`Assets\_Project\Scripts\Controllers\Combat\ImportFXHandle.cs`** — class `ImportFXHandle`. Minimal auto-return helper: `OnDisable()` raises a pool Return event for `poolName`. Attached to imported FX prefabs.

Element-variant siblings in the same folder: `ImpactCannonHit.cs`, `ImpactCannonCommon.cs`/`ImpactCannonCommonGrass/Winter/Lighten.cs` (per-element impact-cannon implementations).

## 3. Network Skill/Effect Synchronization

**`Assets\_Project\Scripts\Controllers\Network\CastNetwork.cs`** — class `CastNetwork : MonoBehaviourPun, INetworkFireballCaster`. Central RPC hub for replicating skill VFX to other clients. `RequestFireball`/`RPC_OnFireballCast` → `SpawnFireballForOthers` (plays pooled `ParticleSystem`, builds token, `ImpactCannon.StartShoot(isMine:false)`). `RequestGuiLingCast`/`BroadcastSplitGuiLingCast`/`BroadcastGuiLingHitVFX`/`RequestSplitBullet` mirror GuiLing casting, splits, and hit VFX across the network. `BroadcastDamage`/`RPC_DealDamage`/`RPC_ShowDamageNum` sync damage + pooled damage-number popups. Maps Element → pool via `GetVisualPoolByElement`/`GetHitPoolByElement`/`GetGuiLingPoolByElement`/`GetGuiLingHitPoolByElement`.

**`Assets\_Project\Scripts\Controllers\Network\INetworkFireballCaster.cs`** — interface implemented by `CastNetwork`.

## 4. Effect Pooling Infrastructure (runtime instantiation backbone)

**`Assets\_Project\Scripts\Core\PoolHelper.cs`** — static class `PoolHelper`. Zero-GC hot path: `Get(poolName, pos)` → `ObjectPoolManager.GetFromPoolAndActivate`; `Return(poolName, obj)`. Used by all effect spawners.

**`Assets\_Project\Scripts\Core\ObjectPoolManager.cs`** — the pool manager backing `PoolHelper`.

**`Assets\_Project\Scripts\Core\PoolConst.cs`** / **`Assets\_Project\Scripts\Core\PoolConfigSO.cs`** — all effect pool-name constants: `ImpactCannonCommon/Lighten/Winter/GrassPool`, `ImpactCannonHit*Pool`, `ImpactCannonTriggerPool`, `GuiLing{Fire/Lightning/Winter/Grass}Pool`, `GuiLingHit{...}Pool`, `DamageNumPool`, `FireFirePool`, etc.

**`Assets\_Project\Scripts\Core\AttackToken.cs`** — class `AttackToken`. Binds a hit-collider GameObject + VFX GameObject + vfxPoolName; `RecycleAll()` returns both to their pools. Central to the VFX+trigger pairing pattern.

**`Assets\_Project\Scripts\Controllers\Network\NetworkObjectPoolManager.cs`** — networked pool manager (5 effect/pool Instantiate-Play occurrences).

## 5. PowerUp / Rune / Boss Effects

**`Assets\_Project\Scripts\Controllers\PowerUp\PowerUpEffectBase.cs`** — abstract class `PowerUpEffectBase : IPowerUpEffect`. `PlayCollectEffects()` does `Instantiate(collectVFX, pos, Quaternion.identity)` + `PlayClipAtPoint`. Other PowerUp files: `IPowerUpEffect.cs`, `ExperienceMagnetEffect.cs`, and `PowerUpManager.cs` (1 occurrence).

**`Assets\_Project\Scripts\Controllers\Rune\RuneEffectApplier.cs`** — static class `RuneEffectApplier`. Applies rune stat effects to player attributes (Lua hot-update + SO fallback). Stat-only; does not spawn VFX.

**`Assets\_Project\Scripts\Controllers\Enemy\Boss_Horror.cs`** — class `SpiderBoss : EnemyBase` (974 lines, file is named Boss_Horror). Boss attacks: Bite, RayBeam (single fireball), FireballBurst (consecutive fireballs), Roll. Holds `rayBeamPrefab`/`fireballPrefab` and spawns boss projectiles.

**`Assets\_Project\Scripts\Controllers\Character\Pets\Charmander.cs`** — pet that references ParticleSystem (pet VFX).

## 6. Event Channel (skill query / damage)

**`Assets\_Project\Scripts\Core\EventSystem\SkillQueryEventChannelSO.cs`** — `SkillQueryEventChannelSO` used by `ImpactCannon` to query `GetMaxAttackCount` (skill-level stat). `DamageEventArgs.cs`/`DamageDisplayEventArgs.cs` carry hit data; `damageEventChannel`/`playerDamageEventChannel` raise damage consumed by effects/numbers.

## 7. Third-party / Imported FX Scripts (mostly asset-store, reusable)

- `Assets\ImportAssets\JMO Assets\Cartoon FX Remaster\CFXR Assets\Scripts\CFXR_Effect.cs` (+ `CFXR_Effect.CameraShake.cs`, `CFXR_EmissionBySurface.cs`, `CFXR_ParticleText.cs`) — Cartoon FX Remaster effect controllers; `CFXR_Demo.cs` in Demo Assets.
- `Assets\ImportAssets\特效\Hovl Studio\Toon Projectiles 2\Scripts\AutoDestroyPS.cs` / `ProjectileMover.cs` — auto-destroy particle + projectile mover.
- `Assets\ImportAssets\Piloto Studio\Scripts\ParticleHandler.cs` / `ParticleShowcase.cs`.
- `Assets\ImportAssets\Vefects\Trails VFX URP\Scripts\Demo_TurningAroundEffect.cs`.
- `Assets\Effects\QFX\ProjectilesFX\VFX_Resources\Scripts\PFX_ProjectileObject.cs`, `PFX_ProjectileObjectWeapon.cs`, `PFX_ProjectileParticlesWeapon.cs`; demo `DemoEffects.cs`.
- `Assets\SF Studio\Shared\Modules\ProjectileSystem\Scripts\DefaultProjectile.cs` / `ProjectileSpawner.cs` — generic projectile system.
- `Assets\SF Studio\Shared\Modules\ParticleSystemUtils\Scripts\Editor\*Editor.cs` — editor utilities (emission multiplier / sorting layer/order).

## Key runtime effect-instantiation pattern (evidence)
```
// AttackRange_WizardBoy / ImpactCannon / CastNetwork
PoolHelper.Get(visualPool, spawnPos)  → GameObject with ParticleSystem → .Play()
PoolHelper.Get(ImpactCannonTriggerPool, spawnPos) → collider (ImpactCannon)
new AttackToken { hitCollider, vfxEffect, vfxPoolName }  // binds them
// On hit: PoolHelper.Get(ImpactCannonHit*Pool, hitPos).GetComponentInChildren<ParticleSystem>().Play()
// On expire: token.RecycleAll()  →  PoolHelper.Return(...)
```

pattern.description: The glob pattern to match against (e.g., '**/*.py', 'docs/*.md').

path.description: Optional: The absolute path to the directory to search within. If omitted, searches the root directory.

case_sensitive.description: Optional: Whether the search should be case-sensitive. Defaults to false.

include_hidden.description: Optional: Whether to descend into dot-prefixed directories (e.g. '.git/', '.codely-cli/') and match dot-prefixed files. Defaults to false to mirror search content tools. Set to true to scan hidden paths explicitly.

maxResults.description: Optional: Maximum number of file paths to return (default: 100). Use to limit output for broad patterns. When the cap is hit the result is paginated; pass 'offset' set to the previous offset+maxResults to continue.

offset.description: Optional: Number of matching file paths to skip before returning results. Use this to continue after a truncated result's next offset.

## Summary

The project uses a **pooled, network-synchronized (Photon PUN) skill-effect system**. Skill projectiles spawn a *pair* of pooled objects per shot — a visual `ParticleSystem` VFX object plus a separate invisible "trigger" collider object — bound together by an `AttackToken`. Effects are categorized by `Element` (Common/Fire/Lightning/Winter/Grass), each mapping to its own object pool (defined in `PoolConst`/`ObjectPoolConst`). Hit effects play from dedicated "Hit" pools and auto-return via `Invoke`. There is no single central "EffectManager"; spawning is decentralized across per-character `AttackRange_*` spawners, `ImpactCannon`/`GuiLingBase` projectile controllers, and the `CastNetwork` RPC bridge.

## 1. Skill / Projectile Spawners (effect spawning entry points)

**`Assets\_Project\Scripts\Controllers\Combat\AttackRange_WizardBoy.cs`** — class `AttackRange_WizardBoy` (WizardBoy character). Overrides `PerformAttack()`: gets spawn pos + direction, plays SFX `sfx_wizard_fire`, picks a visual pool by element (`ImpactCannonCommon/Lighten/Winter/GrassPool`), fetches pooled VFX + `ImpactCannonTriggerPool` trigger, builds an `AttackToken`, calls `particle.GetComponentInChildren<ParticleSystem>().Play()` and orients VFX. Local-then-network: `SpawnFireballLocal(... isMine:true)` then `_networkCaster.RequestFireball(...)`.

**`Assets\_Project\Scripts\Controllers\Combat\AttackRange_BingNv.cs`** — class `AttackRange_BingNv` (冰女/Ice Girl). GuiLing (鬼灵弹) emitter. Multi-target locking + horizontal/vertical spread. Maps element → GuiLing pool via `GetGuiLingPoolByElement` (PoolConst.GuiLingFire/Lightning/Grass/WinterPool).
